assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a transparent decorative illustration for a premium data generation application's clickable homepage entry card, displayed at about 80 px.
Primary request: an elegant miniature sculptural stack of three porcelain white document sheets, with softly rounded edges, a folded rounded corner, a few subtle blue short horizontal relief lines without any actual text, and one tiny royal-blue rounded data cube resting next to the stack.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, isolated cutout. No ground plane or background.
Style/medium: premium editorial 3D clay, satin porcelain and translucent glass details. Sophisticated restrained craftsmanship.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered compact object occupying roughly 70% of canvas, generous transparent margins, three-quarter view, crisp recognizable silhouette at small size. The document stack is the main silhouette. All object parts stay connected or close together.
Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting from upper left, gentle pale contact shading within the object, polished but calm.
Color palette: porcelain white, royal blue, very pale ice blue.
Materials/textures: smooth rounded satin surfaces, refined soft bevels, a glass-blue edge detail, no grain.
Constraints: no enclosing card, no base, no platform, no landscape, no background shadow blob. No text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, face, eyes, neon or decorative clutter. Transparent alpha around the sculpture.
